name: Al-Ashraf Qansuh al-Ghuri
role: Mamluk Sultan of Egypt from 1501 to 1516
contribution: One of the last and most powerful of the Burji dynasty, he reigned from 1501 to 1516.
legacy: He began casting guns “at a rate and on a scale never known before in the history of the Mamuluk kingdom”.
image_credit: Florentine painter Cristofano dell'Altissimo, 16th century · Public domain

checks.lead: Al-Ashraf Qansuh al-Ghuri (Arabic: الأشرف قانصوه الغوري) or Qansuh II al-Ghawri (c. 1441/1446 – 24 August 1516) was the penultimate Mamluk Sultan of Egypt. One of the last and most powerful of the Burji dynasty, he reigned from 1501 to 1516.
